name: month-picker
purpose: Enter a calendar month without a day (PlainYearMonth) in locale-ordered month and year segments inside a labelled group, or pick one from a non-modal dialog popup with a grid of the twelve months of a year (paged by year), with min/max bounds, unavailable months, localized validation, and native form submission as ISO 8601 YYYY-MM.
whenToUse: A month without a day: billing or reporting periods, card expiry, a month of employment, a monthly budget.
Users should be able to type a month quickly and also look it up in a grid of months.
Month fields with bounds or unavailable months (for example months already closed).
whenNotToUse: A specific day: use Date Picker or Date Input.
A whole year: use Year Picker. A calendar quarter: use Quarter Picker.
A range of months: use two Month Pickers and a cross-field rule.
A handful of fixed months that should stay visible: use Radio Group or Select.
responsive: The group hugs its segments and the button, up to 100% of the container; segments wrap inside the group in very narrow containers. The popup is positioned under the group (bottom-start) by the positioning engine, is at most the viewport width minus a gutter, caps its height to the available space, and scrolls when taller. Density tokens adjust the control height.
rtl: Segment order and separators come from the locale's Intl year/month pattern. Segments render as an LTR-isolated run in every direction, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in segments follow that visual order (not mirrored). The button sits at the inline end of the group. The popup and grid take the resolved direction: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in the grid are mirrored, the page chevrons are flipped, and the popup aligns to the inline start of the group.
theme: Control surface, border, focus, error, hover, selected, primary, and sunken-surface role tokens. The focused segment uses the selected pair; the selected month uses color-primary / color-on-primary; the current month is bold with an inset strong border; unavailable months are muted and struck through, so no state relies on color alone. Forced-colors mode uses Highlight for the focused segment and the selected month, a CanvasText outline for the current month, GrayText for disabled cells and buttons, and a CanvasText popup border.
timezone: Values are PlainYearMonth (no timezone) and never shift. The configured timezone (default UTC, never the host zone) only decides the current month: the cell marked aria-current and the month focused when the popup opens on an empty field. The advanced `today` option pins it to a fixed PlainDate.
security: Label, help text, segment names, cell text, headings, and messages are rendered with textContent and Intl formatting; no HTML parsing. Validation messages never include the entered value; range messages include only the formatted bounds. The popup uses the Popover API; no inline handlers. CSP-safe: positioning writes styles through the CSSOM.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. When `name` is set, a hidden input carries the ISO 8601 month (YYYY-MM); it is empty while the entry is empty or fails a built-in check, and disabled (not submitted) while the picker is disabled. A read-only picker is submitted.

performance.testedScale: 100 instances per page in the performance test; the popup grid (12 cells) is created once per picker and re-rendered per page.

limitations: Only ASCII digits are accepted in segments; other characters are removed.
Single months only; month ranges need two pickers.
The popup has no Cancel/OK buttons: picking a month commits it.
Segment arrow navigation follows visual order and is not mirrored in RTL, because segments render as an LTR run.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
unsupported: Rendering HTML in the label, help text, cells, or messages.
Custom cell content or a custom grid layout.
antiPatterns: Converting a month to a Date or an instant in the browser's local timezone; keep the PlainYearMonth or its YYYY-MM form value.
Storing the displayed month text instead of the ISO form value.
Making the grid the only entry path; the segments stay available for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Relying on the host timezone for the current month; configure `timezone`.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/month-picker: AuiMonthPicker directive ([auiMonthPicker]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/month-picker: AuiMonthPicker component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
